import sys

text, out = sys.argv[1:3]


def esc(c):
    if c in ".+*?()|{}$":
        return "[" + c + "]"            # a bracket expression holds the character as it is
    if c in "[]^":
        return "\\\\" + c
    if c == "\\":
        return "\\\\\\\\"
    return c


open(out, "w").write('name~="%s"\n' % "".join(esc(c) for c in text))

#!/bin/bash
python3 - "$1" "$2" <<'PY'
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

text, out = sys.argv[1:3]
snap = "/tmp/bench66754136-refs.txt"
if not os.path.exists(snap):
    refs = subprocess.run(["sudo", "ctr", "-a", "/run/bench66754136/containerd/containerd.sock", "-n", "k8s.io", "images", "list", "-q"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()
    open(snap, "w").write("\n".join(refs) + "\n")
refs = [r for r in open(snap).read().split() if text in r]
alt = "|".join(re.escape(r).replace("\\", "\\\\") for r in refs)
open(out, "w").write('name~="^(%s)$"\n' % alt)
